name: claude-code-game-studios-codex-adapter
compatibility_goal: Preserve Claude Code Game Studios workflow semantics for Codex through role emulation, command templates, script wrappers, plugin discovery, and explicit collaboration rules.

mappings..claude/agents: .codex/agent-index.json plus source role emulation; read source agent markdown before acting
mappings..claude/settings.json: safety policy and hook intent mapping
mappings..claude/docs/workflow-catalog.yaml: phase and skill routing source of truth
mappings.skills/claude-game-studios/SKILL.md: Codex skill entry point for all Game Studios workflows

unsupported_native_features: native Claude Code slash command UI

codex_equivalents.slash_commands: Invoke by text: Run /command-name using Codex adapter, or use scripts/codex-run-skill.sh.
codex_equivalents.subagents: Invoke by text: Act as agent-name, then read .claude/agents/<agent-name>.md if present.
codex_equivalents.hooks: Run scripts manually, via Git hooks, or CI.
codex_equivalents.permissions: Follow deny/allow policy documented in AGENTS.md. Ask before destructive actions.

session_boot_sequence: Read skills/claude-game-studios/SKILL.md when installed as a Codex plugin
Read matching agent/skill/rule files before acting

write_policy.dangerous_commands: deny unless explicitly requested and explained
